term: clock reading of a supertask moment
definition: The real time assigned to each moment of the omega-plus-one supertask order (SupertaskMoment): stage n is read at its Zeno stage time and the distinct limit endpoint at time 1. It is an order embedding when SupertaskPrecedes a b holds exactly when a is read strictly before b.
note: Connects the metric schedule to the existing order vocabulary of TruthCore.Causality.Supertasks instead of a parallel stage type. The endpoint's time is stipulated as 1; the proved convergence of the stage times to 1 is what makes that choice the limit of the schedule rather than an arbitrary later time.
